clusters.pick_reason: PR #2259 includes an additional `if self._terminated: return` idempotency guard at the top of `terminate()` that PR #2253 omits, preventing double-termination if `terminate()` is called concurrently or twice. members.author: weiguangli-io
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2259: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI incomplete-response errors.
